Both the applications are under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with C.T. Case No.44 of 2023 arising out of Phulbani Sadar P.S. Case No.12 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M.,
Phulbani for offences punishable under sections 451/294/323/354- B/427/376(1)/379/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
opennyai_summary.decision:
The prayer for bail of the petitioners was rejected by the learned Addl. Sessions Judge -cum- Special Judge, Phulbani vide order dated 10.03.2023.
In view of 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim, who implicated the petitioners in the commission of rape, while not inclining to release the petitioners on bail, liberty is granted to the petitioners to renew their prayer for bail after examination of the victim in the learned trial Court.
